transfer.intake.title: Send · Intake
transfer.intake.lead: Every book enters here: web upload or scp into inbox. Goes into the master library as-is, bytes untouched. The shelf no longer optimizes books — optimize them on your computer with sheng-ren's xochitl mode first, then add them to xochitl from "Master library".
transfer.intake.usbHint: For big books, use USB https://10.11.99.1 — doesn't use Wi-Fi.
transfer.upload.title: Upload
transfer.upload.dropLabel: Click or drop books (multiple ok · {native} only)
transfer.upload.hint: Only EPUB / PDF is accepted. Non-book files (images / archives) are rejected. Optimize books on your computer with sheng-ren (booklib, xochitl mode) before uploading; nothing is optimized here anymore.
transfer.staging.title: Master library
transfer.staging.optDetailsSummary: Where books get optimized · why the master copy is always kept
transfer.staging.optNote: The shelf no longer optimizes books (since 2026-10-07): layout cleanup, footnotes, comic padding and covers are all done on your computer with sheng-ren's xochitl reading mode; the result is uploaded and added to xochitl here as-is. If a comic carries sheng-ren's page-margin marker, its margin is set to the minimum automatically the first time you open it. The master copy is always kept — so you can add it again after switching devices; delete it yourself from the list once you don’t need it.

transfer.staging.delivered.native.staleT: The master file changed after it was added to xochitl (modified later than the add); xochitl still has the old version. Re-adding creates a new copy — remove the old one yourself.

transfer.staging.render.pendingTitle: Waiting for xochitl to finish rendering after adding, to auto-check the page count (up to 10 minutes)
transfer.staging.render.noneTitle: No render result from xochitl within 10 minutes (reading is unaffected; the page count just isn't recorded here). Don't re-add to re-check — that would create a second copy in xochitl.
transfer.staging.stalePending.title: A service or device restart interrupted the last run — the status got stuck at "in progress" and was never updated. It is not still running; please retry.
transfer.guide.summary: How does the master library work? (click to expand)
transfer.guide.steps.dd: ① Intake: upload (book formats) / scp into inbox — the book goes into the master library as-is, bytes untouched. Optimize books on your computer with sheng-ren's xochitl mode first. ② Add to xochitl: select it and click "Add to xochitl". The master copy stays put, so you can add it again any time after switching devices. The "Other → xochitl" page only manages fonts, not book transfer.
transfer.guide.format.dd: Only {native} is accepted — convert and optimize anything else on your computer before uploading (sheng-ren's xochitl mode outputs EPUB). Books over about 90MB go through the large-file channel and are added whole (a placeholder is uploaded, then replaced with the real file; up to 1GB), no longer split into volumes. PDFs are added as-is, untouched.
transfer.guide.native.dd: The book appears in the xochitl library (in the folder chosen above) and opens in xochitl's own reader: TOC navigation, footnotes, font switching, direct handwritten annotation; highlights and handwriting can be organized and sent to AI in the "Notes" tab.

assets.uiFont.hint: Changes only the font of the xochitl interface (menus, settings, file names, dialogs); reading is unaffected: these fonts are not added to the reader's font menu and are not used as the CJK fallback inside books. Upload below and pick one; takes effect after a full device reboot. notes.title: Notes
notes.lead: Highlight and jot notes in the margin, then close the book — new annotations land in "Browse" first: take a look, click "Send to notes" to transcribe it and move it to "Organize" for review, or "Not needed" to skip it for good. Model keys are configured on the "Manage" tab.
notes.rescanTitle: Clear the page record and re-ingest the whole book
notes.trash.lead: This holds annotations skipped via "Not needed" / "Not needed anymore", plus entries auto-flagged after their strokes were erased — neither projection uses them anymore, but they stay in the entry store until you clear them by hand. Restoring puts an entry roughly back where it was (proofread text still there → back to "Proofread"; only a draft → back to "To proofread"; only handwriting, never transcribed → back to "To transcribe"; nothing left at all → back to "Browse" to decide again).
notes.trash.purgeTitle: Permanently remove the entries listed below — cannot be undone
notes.import.lead: An independent path from "Browse/Organize" above: skips the entry store entirely and turns one .md file directly into a new device notebook document, placed in the currently selected book's own device folder. Headings/lists/todos become native xochitl styles; inline bold/italic only has its markup stripped, it doesn't render (typed styling applies to a whole paragraph, not half a sentence); checked todos can't be written as checked, they land unchecked.

manage.foundation.title: Setup · foundation
manage.foundation.lead: Shelf's features are built on top of xovi + qt-resource-rebuilder. Use the desktop reManager (or vellum on the device) to get the foundation in place first, then come back here to manage each shelf feature.
manage.foundation.links: Downloads / docs: reManager (desktop · vellum ecosystem) · xovi
manage.modules.title: Shelf features
manage.modules.lead: Each feature can be toggled or uninstalled independently; a not-installed one only shows the install command. The gateway (this page) is always on.
manage.modules.helpSummary: What do the three states / toggle / uninstall / install mean? (click to expand)
manage.modules.help.states.dd:
Not installed nothing on the device yet → run the given command to install.
Installed · off present but not running in the background → the page can't show its features, click "Enable".
On running in the background → its features are usable (fonts/wallpapers under "Other", note features under "Notes").
manage.modules.help.toggle.dd: Disable only stops the background service: its features are unavailable on the page (the master library prompts you to enable it), but what's already taken effect keeps working — an installed font is still selectable in the reader, a wallpaper still shows; you just can't push/change it from the web anymore. Useful for hiding features you don't use and shrinking the exposed surface.
manage.modules.help.perf.dt: Does leaving everything on lag or drain the battery?
manage.modules.help.perf.dd: Hardly. The services sit blocked waiting for requests and only do work when you use the web page or an event arrives. No perceptible impact on reading or note-taking. Recommended to leave everything on unless you're sure you'll never use a given feature.
manage.modules.help.uninstall.dd: Removes that feature's program, systemd unit, and any injected files (qmd). Books/fonts/wallpapers etc. you've already transferred are kept. After uninstalling it disappears from the page; reinstall with the install command to bring it back. The gateway itself can't be disabled or uninstalled from the web — it's the host of this Manage page.
manage.modules.help.install.dt: Why isn't installing done from the web?
manage.modules.help.install.dd: Installing needs to remount a read-only system partition and write system units — risk is higher. Not-installed features only get a command: run it over SSH from a computer, or go through reManager's guided setup instead, which is safer.
manage.modules.confirmUninstall: Uninstall {label}? Removes its service/unit/related qmd (user data is kept).
manage.modules.confirmAllOff: Disable every domain service (keep the gateway)?
manage.models.title: Models
manage.models.lead: Cloud models used by the notes line for transcribing annotations (vision model) and Ask AI (text model). Pick a preset combination — no need to fill in a service address yourself; a type with no key configured just won't be usable for its feature.
manage.enhance.hlSnap.title: CJK highlight snapping
manage.enhance.hlSnap.desc: Highlighting Chinese text snaps precisely to word/line boundaries instead of "highlight a bit, grab the whole line". The hl-snap extension in xochitl reads this toggle on every highlight, so changes apply immediately without a restart.
manage.lab.importMd.title: Import md file
manage.lab.importMd.desc: Once enabled, an "Import md file" sub-tab appears on the "Notes" tab (upload a .md file to generate a device notebook document). New feature, off by default — turn it on here to use it.

manage.enhance.pageTurn.desc: Only affects xochitl's built-in reader and is off by default; it is read when a book is opened, so reopen the book after changing it.
manage.enhance.pageTurn.tapHint: Tap the left or right edge (about 7% wide, 45%–80% of the screen height) to turn pages: right edge = next, left edge = previous. Elsewhere taps work as usual (double-tap for text, links).
health.title: Device health
health.lead: A read-only check-up: data is collected only when you open this screen or press Refresh, never sampled in the background. Tap a badge for details.
health.deletedTitle: xochitl is still running the old copy of these extensions (marked (deleted) in its memory map). The new files take effect after a device reboot; don't restart xochitl on its own (it may crash while exiting)
health.soPendingTitle: ~/.cangjie-stage/so-pending/ holds new .so files (xochitl was using the old ones at deploy time); they are swapped in automatically on the next device reboot
health.fw.pending: Computing (runs once, 30 s after the gateway starts)
health.extClean: No extension is waiting on a reboot, and nothing is staged to be swapped in.
health.fw.unknownTitle: The sha256 of /usr/bin/xochitl is not in packaging/firmware-allowlist.txt as built into the gateway: the firmware may have just been updated, or the suite was installed on new firmware with --force
health.servicesHint: "Up at … after boot" is when the service last became active; the duration includes pre-start steps. If a service was restarted after boot, these numbers are for that restart.
health.restartsTitle: How many times systemd has restarted this service since boot
health.prevBoot: Last 20 log lines from the previous boot
health.prevBootNone: Not available: the device journal is not persistent (kept in memory only), so the previous boot's log is gone after a restart.

cleanup.lib.title: Books in the xochitl library
cleanup.lib.desc: Old duplicate copies (such as the per-volume Naruto parts sent earlier) cannot be identified reliably, so nothing is picked automatically. The library's EPUBs and PDFs are listed for you to check (notebooks are not listed). Ticked books go through xochitl's own Move to Trash and can be restored from the xochitl trash; the gateway never deletes library files directly.
